title: Kourovka Notebook Problem 21.29
exact_target: In a finite primitive action that has a trivial two-point stabilizer, can one find a point simultaneously giving trivial stabilizers with any prescribed two points?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2538 (KOU-21.29). CC BY 4.0.

T. C. Burness and M. Giudici, Problem 21.29, in E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), \emph{The Kourovka Notebook: Unsolved Problems in Group Theory}, 21st edition, arXiv:1401.0300v48 (6 October 2026). This version records a negative answer; the displayed question is the historically registered target.
